steps.title: Struts
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as leg.ipt.

Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane. Draw the front strut 40 wide from the front foot (20, 45) up to the front beam (0, 330), and the rear strut 40 wide from the rear foot (528, 45) up to the rear beam (330, 330).
steps.note: The origin is the front track fitting point on the floor.

steps.title: Chord and brace
actions: Sketch a 30 mm bar between the two beam points and a 30 mm brace from the front foot to the rear beam. Extrude 10 mm, Symmetric, Join.
steps.note: Struts, chord and brace make two triangles: a braced frame carries load by tension and compression, not bending.

steps.title: Beam bosses and feet
actions: Sketch circles diameter 70 on the beam points and 60 x 20 pads under each foot. Extrude 10 mm, Symmetric, Join.

steps.title: Bores
actions: Hole: diameter 50 Through All on both bosses (the beam tubes), and diameter 20 on the front strut 150 mm up (the baggage bar). Material: Aluminum 7075-T6. Save.
steps.note: See the FEA: the leg under a 9 g forward crash load.
